resolved_conflicts.explanation: FireLookout.com's text places the L-4 cab's destruction in the winter of 2011/2012, while its page heading gives 2011 as the end date. The story uses the text and reports the heading.

notes_for_editor: Nearly all Johnson Peak history comes from one page (FireLookout.com). The 1966 Forest Service list names only 'Johnson', so that staffing entry is likely but not confirmed to be this peak. Idaho's Johnson Peak Lookout (CDA region, idahofirelookouts.com) is a different lookout and was not used. The Forest Lookouts page for Johnson Peak has only a header with agency and township, so it was cited for the agency alone.
